title: Aegis policy signers file (aegis-policy-signers-v1)
description: The keys a verifier checks a signed policy with (common/signed_policy.py load_signers, docs/audit-and-policy.md): STATE_DIR/policy-signers.json or --policy-signers FILE. With it, the verifier runs only from a policy signed by one of these keys, for this audience if one is named. Every key is known: anything else refuses the file. The verifier's own identity key is refused as a signer, and a key may be listed once.

audience.description: the fleet: a signed policy must name exactly this audience (claim 6)
